checks.name: OSM checks run on the emulator
OSM imports add no Internet or location permission
XML indexes tagged current features and omits geometry-only/deleted objects
Extract timestamp and declared bounds are retained separately
Node and way IDs remain distinct even with the same number
Coordinates and original opening-hours tag are preserved
Missing tags remain absent rather than false
Complete way geometry yields an explicitly approximate center
Missing relation geometry does not invent coordinates
Evidence retains snapshot limits and OSM attribution
Overpass JSON nodes and exported way centers are supported
Incomplete way geometry retains unknown coordinates
Non-finite coordinates are rejected
Ambiguous duplicate object IDs are rejected
DTD/external-entity input is rejected before XML parsing
OSM change files cannot masquerade as current extracts
Overpass error/partial output is rejected
GeoJSON/arbitrary JSON is not silently misread as Overpass data
Excessive JSON nesting is bounded before parsing
Oversized XML attribute tokens are rejected
A node cannot silently use an ambiguous center representation
Parser honors pre-cancellation
Schema4-to5 migration preserves existing document identity/content
Typed OSM features are stored separately from the small document body
Cancellation during indexing rolls back the whole new extract
Partial OSM index cancellation preserves the prior document and feature rows
The exact original OSM extract is retained offline
Retrieval resolves an exact source feature with its OSM identity
Feature source URL uses the original typed ID
Common place-category aliases remain searchable offline
Repeating identical OSM bytes does not duplicate the extract
Malformed replacement cannot partially overwrite an existing dataset
A rejected replacement preserves existing feature citations
Changed extracts create new snapshots without rebinding old citations
Removing an extract removes its feature index and original file
Removed OSM citations report unavailable
Recursive SAF import accepts both OSM XML and Overpass JSON
Verified Bonsai 4B is ready for the optional OSM chat check
Add file imports and indexes the OSM extract through the Activity
Source reader shows original feature facts with OSM attribution
Real offline chat answers from the imported OSM feature and cites its source
